Docs/Connectors/Device controls

Device controls

Flashlight, volume, brightness and modes, hands free.

EssentialsRuns on: Your phoneOn for a fresh install

Every tool in this connector

Changes simple settings for you: flashlight, brightness, volume, ringer, Do Not Disturb, media keys and auto-rotate. Ultron picks the right tool from what you say, so you never have to name one.

Flashlight

Turn the flashlight on or off.

UltronReady

Torch on kar do.

Flashlight

Device controlsTurns the flashlight on. Say off and it goes off.
  1. Hears youLive voice, in your own language
  2. Picks FlashlightTurn the flashlight on or off.
  3. Does itTurns the flashlight on. Say off and it goes off.
  4. Tells youAnswers by voice and on screen

You say: Torch on kar do. Ultron: Turns the flashlight on. Say off and it goes off.
